## Description

The pricing decision record, before any subscription code: ADR-019 (docs/adr/ADR-019-subscription-pricing.md) records the 6 Nov 2026 prices (Solo, Clinic per doctor, Hospital custom; INR and AED; monthly and yearly), the 14-day trial with no card, the limits (doctors, staff, locations, Medvya Assist visits; patients not counted), the defaults decided on 15 Nov 2026, and that plans are versioned data in the platform control plane. Superseded for the building work by MDV-P5-042 (versioned plans in the console), MDV-P5-043 (subscriptions, Medvya invoices with GST/VAT, seats, dunning, owner billing) and MDV-P5-065 (collecting payments).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the subscription work, when it starts, then the pricing decision is recorded in an ADR first (ADR-019).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given ADR-019, when it is read, then it names the prices per country in minor units, the trial, what counts toward a limit, who may change a plan and that dunning never locks patient records.

## Notes / open questions

- Superseded by MDV-P5-042, MDV-P5-043 and MDV-P5-065: the original scope (plans, trial, Medvya invoices, payment collection, dunning) is built there.
- Direction (ADR-016 (docs/adr/ADR-016-organisation-onboarding-and-approval.md, owner decision 10 Nov 2026)): the owner upgrades the plan themselves, self-service, when the clinic adds more doctors, staff or patients than the plan allows, and is responsible for that choice. Seats are doctors, staff and patients; no individual account exists, so a one-doctor clinic is a Clinic plan with one seat.
